name: Willow Watch
tagline: The command center for everyone who cares for our elders.
positioning: Willow Watch unifies care plans, shift coverage, and family updates into one calm system built for the owner-operators running home-care agencies.

hero.h1: The operating system for the last chapter of care.
hero.sub: Retire the binders, the group texts, and the whiteboard. Willow Watch gives your agency one source of truth for every client, caregiver, and worried family member.

features.title: One living care plan
features.description: Every diagnosis, preference, and medication window lives in a single plan your whole team edits in real time — no more photocopied intake packets.

features.title: Coverage that never breaks
features.description: See open shifts, call-outs, and drive times on one board. Fill a gap in two taps before a family ever notices it happened.

features.title: Families in the loop, automatically
features.description: Adult children get a quiet daily summary — visits completed, meals, mood — without a single phone call to your office manager.

features.title: Audit-ready in one click
features.description: State survey next week? Export signed visit notes, EVV logs, and care plan history as a timestamped packet in seconds.

features.title: Medication windows you can trust
features.description: Caregivers get the right MAR at the right hour, and missed doses escalate to the on-call nurse instead of getting lost.

features.title: Every client at a glance
features.description: A live census board flags fall risk, hospital returns, and unstaffed clients so nothing quietly slips through the cracks.

testimonials.quote: We grew from 40 to 190 clients without adding a single scheduler. Willow Watch is the only reason my office manager still sleeps.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: Our last state survey took forty minutes instead of three days. The auditor asked what software we used — I finally felt ahead instead of behind.
testimonials.name: Karen Whitfield

testimonials.quote: The family updates cut our inbound calls in half. Daughters in three time zones now trust us because they can see the visit happened.
testimonials.name: Daniel Okafor

pricing.blurb: For the owner-operator running a single team from the kitchen table.
For growing agencies juggling coverage, compliance, and real census.
For multi-branch operators standardizing care across regions.

homepage.footerBlurb: Willow Watch is the coordination layer for home-care agencies — because the people who care for our elders deserve tools worthy of the work.
